text:
The court should dismiss under the Speech or Debate Clause (U.S. Const. art. I, §6, cl. 1), which gives members of Congress absolute immunity from suits based on legislative acts, and a Senate floor speech is one. Because that immunity bars the suit outright, the complaint fails regardless of its falsity or negligence allegations, so the actual-malice pleading gap is a weaker, secondary ground.

CONFIDENCE: 85
